CONTRACT REPORT:
Two commits on main.

1) 7654f56 "Q1 leftovers: deterministic main-1024 visual screen; expect reason in vendored sqlite3mc; tidy CI comment"
- Root cause of the main-1024 flake: TanStack Virtual rounds row heights (Math.round of the border box, or offsetHeight), but the rows are fractional (111.22 px). Its scrollToIndex therefore aligned the selected row about 1.5 px short of where Playwright's own scroll had put it, and which of the two won depended on scroll-event timing. Fix: MessageList measures rows exactly (exactRowSize in ui/src/widgets/MessageList.tsx). The selected row is now fully visible.
- Regenerated main-1024 and html (Comfortable) baselines, whose scroll position changed. Also regenerated the High contrast Comfortable baselines for main, menu, more, html and dialog: these failed identically on HEAD (stale, captured before M5c's read-state fix). No tolerance was changed.
- Added a reason to the sqlite3mc expect attribute and moved the licences/advisories comment back onto the deny job in ci.yml.
- Updated plan.md (Q1 gate met) and the q1-status memory.
- Defect in that commit: exactRowSize returned 0 under jsdom, which broke 13 vitest tests; I only ran a subset before committing. The fix is in the second commit (it falls back to TanStack's measureElement when there is no layout).

2) b6ee3bb "M5d: contract and slots" (ADR docs/adr/0131-m5d-contract.md)
- Layout edits: new LayoutPatch kinds sent through UpdateLayout, which gains an optional base_revision. move-pane takes a LayoutPlacement: into {parent, index}, or beside {target, side} to dock. The others are swap-panes, add-widget (NewWidget), remove-node, set-hidden, apply-preset, reset-window, and move-/add-/remove-toolbar-item (ToolbarSlot bar|more). kind() / kind_of() give the label of each undo entry.
- layout.kdl:
  - Any node takes `hidden=#true`; the renderer skips hidden nodes.
  - New `presets` section, giving ResolvedLayout.presets. Four default mail presets over the panes sidebar / list-pane / reader. A preset naming panes a user layout lacks is deliberately not a config error, so existing user layouts keep working; ApplyPreset refuses that breakpoint instead.
  - Default layout also gets actions layout.customize / toolbar.customize and `menu "context:toolbar"`.
  - Registered widget kinds layout-editor-settings, toolbar-editor-settings and theme-editor (not placed anywhere), plus 8 Lucide icons.
  - Schema, fixtures and the user layout reference are updated.
- Theme edits: EditTheme (target user|theme; set-token / set-part-property / reset-part), DuplicateTheme and RenameTheme (both answer ThemeSaved), DeleteTheme, and GetThemeDetails → ThemeDetails with the origin of each value.
- Undo history in nail-config/src/edit_history.rs, one per scope (layout / appearance). It records before/after file text for every write: UpdateLayout, SetTheme, SetThemePreferences, merges and reverts. 50 entries per scope, kept in memory. New requests GetEditHistory / UndoEdit / RedoEdit and event EditHistoryChanged; the event is also sent when the watcher sees the files change.
- Conflicts: a file's revision (config_revision, FNV-1a 64) is checked against base_revision. Undo and redo check that the files still hold what the entry expects, otherwise they answer conflict / edit-issue-conflict; with force, theme.kdl / layout.kdl are backed up first and then replaced.
- Core: nail-core/src/editing.rs plus routing, remote access (reads need a session, edits need admin) and history broadcasts.
- Stubs answering unsupported / edit-issue-not-ready until the packages land: the new layout patches (nail-config layout_edit.rs), the theme operations after their theme checks (theme_edit.rs), and the mock patch appliers in ui features/layout-editor/mock.ts, features/toolbar-editor/mock.ts and appearance/themeEditMock.ts.
- UI: state/editHistory.ts hooks; App.tsx applies EditHistoryChanged. layout/LayoutChrome.ts gives LayoutChromeContext {showHidden, renderNode(node, ref, content)}; the renderer passes every node through it. api/editHistoryMock.ts implements the mock history (registerMockHistoryScope, recordMockEdit, simulateExternalEdit, base revision checks).
- New feature slots layout-editor and toolbar-editor, registered centrally with placeholder actions and widgets. New locales core-editors.ftl (contract ids), layout-editor.ftl and toolbar-editor.ftl, each with an empty de file. No new dependencies: react-aria-components (Apache-2.0) already provides drag and drop and colour pickers.
- Slot table (ADR 0131):
  - WP181: features/layout-editor, layout/LayoutRenderer.tsx and LayoutChrome.ts, and placing the settings widgets in defaults/layout.kdl.
  - WP182: features/toolbar-editor, widgets/Toolbar.tsx and toolbarModel.ts.
  - WP183: features/appearance and the inspector's "Edit style".
  - WP184: crates/nail-config.
- CLAUDE.md, plan.md M5d status, memory m5d-contract and the MEMORY index are updated. I did not commit .claude/memory/next-steps.md and .claude/workflows/args/m5d.json; those changes are the orchestrator's.
